action: Call Rick Tanner directly — not email, a phone call — and tell him the two weeks he mentioned are almost up and I am still holding. I am not pressuring him, I am making myself easy to say yes to. I say: 'Rick, you told me two weeks. I wanted you to know I have not taken anything else and I am ready for that conversation whenever you are.' I keep it short. I let him respond. If he has an answer, I am ready to move. If he needs more time, I note the date and give him a hard follow-up window in my own head.
